blocks.text: This year the Editions sector brings together 48 publishers and specialist booksellers. Located on the first floor along the walkways and in the Galerie Courbe of the Grand Palais, it offers a panorama of international photographic publishing, from contemporary publications to historical and rare books.

Alongside publishers such as MACK (London), Atelier EXB (Paris) and Aperture (New York), the 2026 edition welcomes newcomers including Gato Negro and Obsidiana (Mexico City), Palm* Studios (London) and Sun Archive (Wrocław), as well as Fw:Books (Netherlands).
Throughout the fair, publishers host more than 400 book-signing sessions at their booths, allowing the public to meet artists and authors around their publications.
Matthieu Charon, Co-founder of RVB Books, Paris
Paul Schiek, Founder of TBW Books, Oakland
Akio Nagasawa, Founder of the gallery and publishing house Akio Nagasawa, Tokyo
Anne König, Co-founder of Spector Books, Leipzig
Paris Photo Nov. 12–15, 2026 | Grand Palais 1 pm – 8 pm (Sunday 7 pm) Avenue Winston Churchill 75008, Paris, France Booth P01 www.parisphoto.com
